Combine saved Reaches under one retained identity

study_reach_merge.Rd

Verifies retained source evidence and combines its inherited-buffer geometry under one selected Reach identity. Other selected identities leave the current inventory but remain in prior revisions. No source files are changed.

preview_study_reach_merge(dsn, reach_ids, retain_reach_id)
merge_study_reaches(dsn, output_file, reach_ids, retain_reach_id,
  reach_name, report_purpose = "definition")

Arguments

dsn

Existing study context GeoPackage.

output_file

New context GeoPackage beside dsn; never overwritten.

reach_ids

Two or more distinct saved Reach identities from one Stream.

retain_reach_id

One selected identity to retain.

reach_name

Combined Reach name, unique in its parent Stream.

report_purpose

Revision purpose: definition, terrain or staging.

Details

Survey Events retain their IDs, dates and attributes; only retired parent Reach IDs are reassigned. Linked network and terrain-manifest references require separate reconciliation and block this operation. Missing, changed or stale Reach evidence also blocks merging. Evidence-first publication may leave an unreferenced evidence file on failure. Disconnected parts and overlaps are not repaired. Neither a complete network nor scientific acceptance is inferred.

Value

Preview returns the combined corridor, source mapping, retained and retired IDs, retained name and reassigned event count. Save returns revision paths, evidence and the retained reach_id.
